english: Find the note, photo or field observation you need again.
afrikaans_before: Vind die nota, foto of veldwaarneming wat jy weer nodig het.
back_translation: Find the note, photo or field observation you need again.

english: Search journal titles, notes, crops and beds
afrikaans_before: Soek joernaaltitels, notas, gewasse en beddings
back_translation: Search journal titles, notes, crops and beds

english: Both dates are included. Leave either date empty for an open range.
afrikaans_before: Albei datums word ingesluit. Laat enige datum leeg vir 'n oop reeks.
back_translation: Both dates are included. Leave any date empty for an open range.

english: Keep a copy of this {n} entry
back_translation: Keep a copy of these {n} entry

english: Keep a copy of these {n} entries
back_translation: Keep a copy of these {n} entries

english: Works offline. Only the matching entries are included. You can include saved photo thumbnails in the printable copy.
afrikaans_before: Werk vanlyn. Slegs die passende inskrywings word ingesluit. Jy kan gestoorde foto-duimnaelskets in die drukbare kopie insluit.
back_translation: Works offline. Only the matching entries are included. You can include saved photo thumbnails in the printable copy.

english: Leave this on to include saved photo thumbnails. Turn it off for a smaller copy with notes only.
afrikaans_before: Los dit aan om gestoorde foto-duimnaelskets in te sluit. Skakel dit af vir 'n kleiner kopie met slegs notas.
back_translation: Leave it on to include saved photo thumbnails. Switch it off for a smaller copy with notes only.

english: These notes stay on this device. Keep a copy before clearing browser storage or changing phones.
afrikaans_before: Hierdie notas bly op hierdie toestel. Hou 'n kopie voordat jy die blaaier se gestoorde data uitvee of van foon verander.
back_translation: These notes stay on this device. Keep a copy before you delete the browser's saved data or change phone.

english: CSV downloaded. It contains the entries shown here.
afrikaans_before: CSV afgelaai. Dit bevat die inskrywings wat hier gewys word.
back_translation: CSV downloaded. It contains the entries shown here.

english: Printable copy downloaded. Open the HTML file, then choose Print or Save as PDF in your browser.
afrikaans_before: Drukbare kopie afgelaai. Maak die HTML-lêer oop en kies dan Druk of Stoor as PDF in jou blaaier.
back_translation: Printable copy downloaded. Open the HTML file, then choose Print or Save as PDF in your browser.

english: The file could not be prepared. Your notes are unchanged. Try again.
afrikaans_before: Die lêer kon nie voorberei word nie. Jou notas is onveranderd. Probeer weer.
back_translation: The file could not be prepared. Your notes are unchanged. Try again.

english: Try another word, a wider date range, or clear the filters. Your saved notes are still here.
afrikaans_before: Probeer 'n ander woord, 'n wyer datumreeks, of maak die filters skoon. Jou gestoorde notas is steeds hier.
back_translation: Try another word, a wider date range, or clear the filters. Your saved notes are still here.

english: The start date must be on or before the end date.
afrikaans_before: Die begindatum moet op of voor die einddatum wees.
back_translation: The start date must be on or before the end date.

english: Open a photo or compare two dates. These are the pictures saved with your notes.
afrikaans_before: Maak 'n foto oop of vergelyk twee datums. Dit is die foto's wat saam met jou notas gestoor is.
back_translation: Open a photo or compare two dates. These are the photos saved together with your notes.

english: Dates and captions come from your notes. Photos alone do not measure growth or prove a yield.
afrikaans_before: Datums en onderskrifte kom uit jou notas. Foto's alleen meet nie groei nie en bewys nie 'n opbrengs nie.
back_translation: Dates and captions come from your notes. Photos alone do not measure growth and do not prove a yield.

english: Draft from your crop plan. Check what happened before saving. Today is selected; choose the day you actually did the work. This does not record a harvest quantity or mark the task complete.
afrikaans_before: Konsep uit jou gewasplan. Kontroleer wat gebeur het voordat jy stoor. Vandag is gekies; kies die dag waarop jy die werk werklik gedoen het. Dit teken nie 'n oeshoeveelheid aan nie en merk nie die taak as voltooi nie.
back_translation: Draft from your crop plan. Check what happened before you save. Today is selected; choose the day on which you actually did the work. It does not record a harvest quantity and does not mark the task as complete.

afrikaans_before: Teken aan wat jy gepluk het
note: "gepluk" is picked/plucked; it matches the English "picked" but "oes" is the usual farm word for harvest. Left as the English has it.

afrikaans_before: Teken aan wat jy gepluk het: {title}

english: Saved copies (CSV and printable) are in English. Your notes keep their original language.
afrikaans_before: Gestoorde kopieë (CSV en drukbaar) is in Engels. Jou notas behou hul oorspronklike taal.
back_translation: Saved copies (CSV and printable) are in English. Your notes keep their original language.

english: Farmers with production or sales records
back_translation: Farmers with production or sales records

english: Farmers active in the last 90 days
afrikaans_before: Boere wat in die laaste 90 dae aktief was
back_translation: Farmers who were active in the last 90 days

english: Based on recorded activity; this does not establish continued participation
afrikaans_before: Gebaseer op aangetekende aktiwiteit; dit bewys nie voortgesette deelname nie
back_translation: Based on recorded activity; it does not prove continued participation

english: Vegetable beds + staple plots; physical area counted once
afrikaans_before: Groentebeddings + stapelgewaspersele; fisiese oppervlakte een keer getel
back_translation: Vegetable beds + staple-crop plots; physical area counted once

english: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include production
afrikaans_before: {n} van {m} sigbare boerrekords sluit produksie in
back_translation: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include production

english: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include sales
afrikaans_before: {n} van {m} sigbare boerrekords sluit verkope in
back_translation: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include sales

english: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include expenses
afrikaans_before: {n} van {m} sigbare boerrekords sluit uitgawes in
back_translation: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include expenses

english: {n} visible farmer records; coverage is not total project reach
afrikaans_before: {n} sigbare boerrekords; dekking is nie die projek se totale bereik nie
back_translation: {n} visible farmer records; coverage is not the project's total reach

english: Area figures use each garden’s latest observation. Farmer production and finances use available cumulative records, whose reporting periods and coverage may differ.
afrikaans_before: Oppervlaktesyfers gebruik elke tuin se jongste waarneming. Boere se produksie en finansies gebruik beskikbare kumulatiewe rekords, wie se verslagtydperke en dekking kan verskil.
back_translation: Area figures use each garden's latest observation. Farmers' production and finances use available cumulative records, whose reporting periods and coverage may differ.
note: "rekords, wie se verslagtydperke" uses "wie se" for things; "waarvan die" is more natural. Meaning clear.

english: Sales are revenue. Profit and R/m² require costs, production area and dates matched to the same activity; those ratios are not calculated here.
afrikaans_before: Verkope is inkomste. Wins en R/m² vereis koste, produksie-oppervlakte en datums wat by dieselfde aktiwiteit pas; daardie verhoudings word nie hier bereken nie.
back_translation: Sales are income. Profit and R/m² require costs, production area and dates that fit the same activity; those ratios are not calculated here.

english: {n} enrolled farmers are withheld from the portfolio for consent.
afrikaans_before: {n} ingeskrewe boere word weens toestemming uit die portefeulje weggelaat.
back_translation: {n} registered farmers are left out of the portfolio because of consent.
afrikaans_after: {n} ingeskrewe boere word weens ontbrekende toestemming uit die portefeulje weggelaat.
note: "weens toestemming" is "because of consent", which does not say consent is missing; a funder could read it as the reverse. Now "weens ontbrekende toestemming" (because of missing consent), so the withholding is explicit.

english: AI-generated example garden aerial. Not a satellite image or photograph of Ubhejane.
afrikaans_before: AI-gegenereerde voorbeeld van 'n tuin uit die lug. Nie 'n satellietbeeld of foto van Ubhejane nie.
back_translation: AI-generated example of a garden seen from the air. Not a satellite image or photo of Ubhejane.

english: AI-generated example harvest. Not evidence of the real garden's production.
afrikaans_before: AI-gegenereerde voorbeeldoes. Nie bewys van die regte tuin se produksie nie.
back_translation: AI-generated example harvest. Not proof of the real garden's production.
